title: Attendance Release Thresholds and Slot-Hold Periods — Appointment Series
content:
For each Appointment Series format, the table gives the number of missed appointments at which a series' future appointments are released, the rolling window over which they are counted, whether late cancellations count with no-shows, the same-day-only booking restriction that follows a release, how long appointments are held while a funding plan of care waits on authorization, and whether a cancelled series can be reopened.

| Visit format | Missed appointments in the window that trigger release | Rolling window (calendar days) | Late cancellations counted with no-shows | Same-day-only booking after a release | Length of that restriction (calendar days) | Appointments held after the plan of care goes on hold for authorization (calendar days) | Cancelled series never reopened; further visits need a new series |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | 3 | 60 | No | Yes | 30 | 7 | Yes |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 3 | 60 | Yes | Yes | 30 | 7 | Yes |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 3 | 60 | Yes | Yes | 30 | 7 | Yes |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 2 | 60 | Yes | Yes | 30 | 5 | Yes |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 2 | 60 | Yes | No | 0 | 10 | Yes |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 3 | 60 | No | No | 0 | 3 | Yes |

## Condition and result, per row

- **Condition:** the count of missed appointments over the rolling window reaches the trigger figure for the format. **Result:** the series' future appointments are released.
- **Condition:** the format shows same-day-only booking after a release. **Result:** for the stated number of calendar days only same-day openings are booked. A restriction length of 0 means no restriction follows.
- **Condition:** an insurance-funded series' plan of care goes on hold for authorization. **Result:** its appointments are held for the stated number of calendar days before they are released.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- On an Aquatic Therapy Visit Series, 2 missed appointments in the 60-day window reach the trigger; on a Standard 45-Minute Visit Series, 2 do not, and a third does.
- On a Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series or a Post-Operative Priority Visit Series, late cancellations are not added to the count; on the other four formats they are.
